description: Identify cointegrating crypto pairs from a 5-symbol candidate pool, evaluate spread mean-reversion signal quality, and assess regime change / structural break risk.
agent_prompt: Research cross-asset alpha from cointegrating pairs in a 5-symbol crypto futures pool. Inputs at /workspace/data/: BTCUSDT_1d_2021_2024.csv, ETHUSDT_1d_2021_2024.csv, SOLUSDT_1d_2021_2024.csv, AVAXUSDT_1d_2021_2024.csv, MATICUSDT_1d_2021_2024.csv. Tasks: (1) for all 10 unordered pairs run Engle-Granger cointegration test (ADF p-value of OLS residuals) and Johansen test (trace statistic vs 95% critical value) on log prices; write /workspace/output/pair_selection.csv with columns pair, eg_pvalue, johansen_trace_stat, johansen_passes_95, half_life_days. (2) For each cointegrating pair (eg_pvalue < 0.05 OR johansen passes), build a rolling 60-day z-score on the spread, define a mean-reversion strategy (enter when |z|>2, exit when |z|<0.5), and compute IC of z-score vs forward 5d spread reversion plus Sharpe of the strategy net of 5bps round-trip cost; write /workspace/output/signal_evaluation.csv with columns pair, ic_mean, ic_tstat, strategy_sharpe, strategy_max_dd. (3) For the top-2 strongest pairs, run a structural break test (Chow test or rolling-window ADF p-value) and document any regime shift; write /workspace/output/regime_analysis.md describing detected breaks, the period they occurred, and implications for live deployment.

required_capabilities: Run Engle-Granger and Johansen cointegration tests on price pairs
Compute spread half-life and rolling z-score signal
Evaluate signal IC and strategy performance metrics
Detect structural breaks or regime changes in cointegrating relationships
Reason about implications of regime change for live deployment
